---
title: "Week 13: Model Basics and Model Building"
---

## Official Topic

Model basics and model building. Quiz 4.

## Problem Focus

What does a statistical model claim, and how do we know when that claim is weak?

Students fit simple models, interpret coefficients, inspect residuals, and discuss assumptions.

## In Class

- Fit a simple linear model.
- Interpret slope and intercept in context.
- Compare fitted values and residuals.
- Discuss prediction limits.

## AI-Aware Task

Ask an LLM to interpret a regression output. Then identify overclaims, missing assumptions, and conclusions not supported by the model.
